en.headline: More than 6,000 cyclists take part in Hong Kong Cyclothon
en.dek: The annual event featured a new 56-kilometre route through the Central Kowloon Bypass for the first time, with start and finish at the West Kowloon Cultural District.
body: More than 6,000 cyclists took part in the 2026 Sun Hung Kai Properties Hong Kong Cyclothon on Sunday, according to organisers and reports.

The Hong Kong Tourism Board staged the event, which included a non-competitive 56-kilometre ride that started at 5:15 a.m. from the West Kowloon Cultural District. The route, described as covering five tunnels and three bridges, included the Central Kowloon Bypass for the first time.

Retired Olympic cyclist Lee Wai-sze was among the early finishers and said the new route offered a different experience. A shorter 32-kilometre ride and a UCI Class 1.1 road race also took place, along with a carnival at the Art Park.
Road closures associated with the event had been lifted by early afternoon, according to transport updates.

zh.headline: 香港單車節逾6千人參與 首度經中九龍繞道
zh.dek: 賽事起終點移至西九文化區，56公里組新增中九龍繞道路段，涵蓋五隧三橋。
body: 據主辦方及報道，周日舉行的2026新鴻基地產香港單車節有超過6,000名車手參與。
旅遊發展局主辦的活動包括清晨5時15分從西九文化區起步的非競賽56公里組。新路線涵蓋五隧三橋，並首次讓車手騎經中九龍繞道。
前奧運單車手李慧詩是較早衝線的參加者之一，她指新路線帶來不同體驗。活動另設32公里組及UCI 1.1級公路賽，西九藝術公園亦有嘉年華。
因賽事而實施的封路措施已於下午早段全部解除。
